case_studies.title: Phase F structural parameter-lock
case_studies.summary: Sensitivity-sweep methodology surfaces structural parameter-lock; (1-bf) cancellation analytical proof; downgrade verdict to PASS_PARAMETER_TUNED. Generalizes to any computational pipeline where coupling layer parameters mask the upstream prediction.

case_studies.title: Kd-vs-EC50 conflation in computational binding calibration
case_studies.summary: Directness-tier audit reveals all 30 ground-truth entries are functional EC50, not strict-Kd. f_allo = 2.50× allosteric correction; LOO-CV validates correction generalizes; 76% → 94% within-10× post-correction. Per Forman & Miller 2016 PMID 27749338 PAM allosteric coupling theory.

case_studies.title: Eger non-immobilizer puzzle as boundary diagnostic
case_studies.summary: CP3 cis/trans-DCE FAIL + CP7 hexafluoroethane FAIL → binding pipeline lacks Eger non-immobilizer discrimination. Documented as boundary, not bug. Multi-target discriminative claim narrowed; binding profile alone is insufficient for anesthetic-specificity.

case_studies.title: twk-18 direction inversion in literature anchor verification
case_studies.summary: Original anchor 6 had fabricated PMID + inverted biological direction (claimed RESISTANT, real is HYPERSENSITIVE per Singaram 2011 PMID 22137475). Mechanism-trace-vs-empirical-direction methodology surfaces inversions reliably.

case_studies.title: Pre-flight pushback as systematic methodology
case_studies.summary: Umbrella thesis: structured pre-flight pushback is cost-effective methodology for AI-assisted scientific work. Cumulative catch-list 37+ citation issues + 1 parameter-lock + 1 direction-inversion + Kd/EC50 conflation + saturation collapse documented.

_meta.umbrella_thesis: Systematic pre-flight pushback is a cost-effective methodology for AI-assisted computational research, particularly for work that grounds claims in primary sources, depends on parameter calibration, or makes direction-sensitive biological predictions.
